IGEO17MMT
                                                                        14 augustus 2021

iGeo 2021 MMT F2                                                       0% (0/40)

  1. In what count y were these photographs taken?

  A   Bolivia

  B   Ecuador

  C   Paraguay

  D   Pe u

  2. In which environments is honeycomb weathe ing most
      abundant?

  A   Environments where lichen occurs, such as tundra or alpine
      areas.

  B   Environments with temperatures around 0°C such as taiga and
      tundra

  C   Salt- ich environments such as dese ts and coastal zones

  D   Monsoon dominated environments such as tropical savannas and
      pampas

  3. This map depicts ships around Istanbul on May 24, 2021 at 21.00
      PM local time. Each color represents a ce tain kind of ship.
      Which photo co responds to which numbered ships on the
      map?

  A   photo A = ship 1, photo B = ship 2, photo C = ship 3

  B   photo A = ship 1, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 2

  C   photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 1, photo C = ship 3

  D   photo A = ship 2, photo B = ship 3, photo C = ship 1

4. Which of the following is found in all the products shown in the
    image?

A   co n

B   palm oil

C   petroleum

D   wheat

    Ge many and Belgium. How are these two events directly
    related?

A   fo mation of a heat dome

B   human-induced climate change

C   poor adaptation strategies

D   position of the jet stream

    foreland basin?

A   Medite ranean Sea A

B   Red Sea B

C   Persian Gulf C

D   Gulf of Aden D

 9. Plot of migration flows between world's top 25 sending and
     receiving count ies in 2005 2010. Axis scale in 100,000s.

     migration in 2005 2010 are cu rently classified by the United

 D   valley glacier

 A   coral

     The map shows rainfall in four catego ies A D

     - it rains a lot but usually doens't pour

     when it does, it pours'?

 D   D

 A   livability in urban areas

 B   CO2-emissions and the climate pandemic

 C   worldwide availability of COVID-vaccines

 D   local production value in a globalising world

     trend is it?

 A   global renewable energy shares

 B   global middle-class consumption

 C   global food sho tages

 D   global fe tility-rate changes

15. Ve meer painted The Astronomer and The Geographer in the 17th
     centu y. Which one is more likely The Geographer and why?

 A   The left because of the interest in the Ea th's movement.

 B   The left because of the dividers used for measu ing distances.

 C   The ight because of the presence of the maps.

 D   The ight because of the celestial globe.

16. These fences on the edge of the road are meant to protect:

 A   the road against blizzards.

 B   animals against road accidents.

 C   crops against pollution

 D   traffic against the fog

17. Name the phenomenon shown here and identify what happens
     next.

 A   Cyclogenesis, the two low pressure systems will merge into one
     system

 B   Cyclogenesis, the two low pressure systems will circle each
     other clockwise

 C   Fujiwhara effect, the two low pressure systems will circle each
     other clockwise

 D   Fujiwhara effect, the two low pressure systems will merge into
     one system

     what purpose are grass st ips replaced by rocks in these
     cities?

 A   To improve infiltration rates to cope with more intensive rainfall.

 B   To get local dwellers more involved in their local geology.

 C   To reduce reflection of sun rays and thereby reduce the urban
     heat island.
 D   To prevent unsheltered people to pitch their tents.

     population prediction graph?

     Leatherbacks (sea tu tles). Both species need the same sea

     species is breeding in area B in July.

     Pacific island Nau u, the economy became worse than it was
     before discove y of the resource. One cause of this so-called
     ‘Dutch disease’ is the unemployed manpower.

     mining

 B   Increasing wealth diseases (e.g. hea t attacks and obesity-levels
     up to 71%), decreasing productivity.

 C   The island inhe its an impo t-o iented infrast ucture from the
     mining indust y.

     indust ies.
